name: Runben Biotechnology
summary: Runben Biotechnology Co., Ltd. focuses on the creation, production, and distribution of mosquito repellent solutions, infant care items, and essential oil products. The company primarily sells its offerings through digital sales channels. Established in 2013, Runben Biotechnology is headquartered in Guangzhou, China, and functions as a division of Guangzhou Zhuofan Investment Holding Co., Ltd.
